goal: Stop release binary verification from counting expired or revoked GPG keys toward the signature threshold
Prevents binary verification from succeeding with entirely inactive keys
agreement: Nonblocking objection: excluding expired keys by default could break verifying older releases (willcl-ark)
Suggested an opt-in flag to allow expired signatures, which the author implemented (sedited, willcl-ark)
Awaiting re-review on the updated flag implementation (willcl-ark, sedited)

categories.name: build
why: P1 because release verification could succeed using entirely expired or revoked keys without active signers
Resolves a critical release-integrity correctness issue disclosed by the Red Team

categories.name: tools
why: P2 because operator verification scripts should not accept lapsed cryptographic keys by default
Ensures binary verification tools correctly handle key status when checking signature quorums
